## Agent-centric components [REPORTED 2026-07-06 — still present, no new components this scan]:
- **Agent Studio** (visual agent builder).
- **Agents** (autonomous agent capabilities, first-class component); Agent Platform SDK (Python/Go/Java/Node.js/C#).
- **Reasoning Engines** with session management + bidirectional streaming / async query.
- **Semantic Governance Policy Engine** (SemanticGovernancePolicyEngine — policy-based control over agent behavior).
- RAG Engine Config with file-transformation pipelines; content corroboration + prompt augmentation.

## Core Capabilities (cached)
- Gemini (multimodal generative AI); Generative AI access + Model Garden; training + MLOps.

## Major Product Categories (cached)
- Training (serverless, clusters, Ray); AutoML (tabular, image); inference/deployment; Feature Store; Model Registry; Pipelines; Experiments.

## Components (cached)
- Vector Search (1.0 / 2.0); Neural Architecture Search; Ray on Vertex AI; dedicated/private endpoints; PSC; Workbench; Colab Enterprise; Jupyter; BigQuery + Cloud Storage integration; data labeling; Model Monitoring; TensorBoard; Deep Learning Containers; custom/distributed training; hyperparameter tuning; model co-hosting; Flex-Start VMs; Cloud TPU VM training; SLURM orchestration.
